name: Does sealing grout prevent mold and mildew?

mainEntity.name: Does sealing grout prevent mold and mildew?

acceptedAnswer.text: While grout sealing significantly reduces the likelihood of mold and mildew growth, it does not completely prevent it. Mold and mildew thrive in damp environments with organic material. A sealant creates a barrier that prevents moisture and organic particles from penetrating the porous grout, making it much harder for mold to take hold and grow within the grout lines. However, surface mold can still form on top of the sealant if an area remains consistently wet and unclean. Regular cleaning and good ventilation are still crucial, especially in bathrooms and kitchens.
acceptedAnswer.description: Grout sealing reduces mold and mildew by preventing moisture and particles from penetrating porous grout. It doesn't eliminate all growth, so cleaning and ventilation are still needed.
